title: TheClearLag
description: A Minecraft Paper 1.21 plugin called TheClearLag, designed to reduce lag by automatically and manually cleaning objects on the ground.
body:
**_TheClearLag_** is a lightweight performance utility for Minecraft 1.21+ servers, designed to automatically manage and clear ground items to combat entity lag.

Key Feature: Scheduled automatic cleanup with a single, clear 15-second warning countdown.

Customization: Full configuration via config.yml allowing adjustment of cycle time (minutes/seconds) and all broadcast messages.

**Commands:**

_/clearlag_: Executes an immediate item cleanup.

_/clearlag reload_: Reloads the configuration file and restarts the automatic task without needing a server reboot.

Permissions: theclearlag.use (for cleanup) and theclearlag.reload (for reloading).

Compatibility: Built for the entire 1.21.x series using the latest Paper API.
